title: Skip intro
note: It's Always Sunny S1 E1 at 1:47. The intro runs 1:44 to 2:11 (TheIntroDB). The chip stays 10 s; OK skips to 2:11. The hint bar shows the first 5 times.

title: Skip intro in the button row
note: The controls are up during the intro (▲ pressed at 1:52). The floating chip moves into the row and ▲ lands on it. Small gaps on the bar mark the intro and the credits; no labels.

title: Skipped automatically
note: Skip automatically is on. S1 E2's intro (1:19 to 1:46) was skipped; for 5 s OK goes back to 1:19. The subtitle line rises above the chip while it shows.

title: Skip recap
note: Lost S2 E1 at 0:06. The recap runs 0:02 to 0:28. Recaps have speech, so the subtitles show and rise above the chip. After 5 views the hint bar stops; the key cap on the chip says what OK does.

title: Up next when the credits start
note: S1 E1 at 21:30. The credits start at 21:28 (TheIntroDB) and no one speaks after it, so Up next comes then (not 40 s from the end) and counts 15 s. Unchanged: OK plays now, Back stays on this one.

title: Options > Skip intros
note: From ▼ Options in an episode. The same setting as Account > Playback > Skip intros. The foot says whether this episode is known.
